mil7.7.3:1.1: bhante Nāgasena, cittakadharakummassa ekaṃ angaṃ gahetabban-ti yaṃ vadesi, kataman-taṃ ekaṃ nagaṃ gahetabban-ti. -
mil7.7.3:1.2: Yathā mahārāja cittakadharakummo udakabhayā udakaṃ pariyajjetvā vicarati, tāya ca pana udakaṃ parivajjanāya āyunā na parihāyati,
mil7.7.3:1.3: evameva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena pamāde bhayadassāvinā bhavitabbaṃ, appamāde guṇavisesadassāvinā,
mil7.7.3:1.4: tāya ca pana bhayadassāvitāya na parihāyati sāmaññā, nibbānassa santike upeti.
mil7.7.3:1.5: Idaṃ mahārāja cittakadharakummassa ekaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.7.3:1.6: Bhāsitam-p' etaṃ mahārāja Bhagavatā devātidevena Dhammapade:
